HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   D. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
